use: Acompañamiento conceptual de la presentación; no son evidencia documental de los casos.

illustrations.prompt: Educational editorial illustration for a Chilean high-school presentation about verifying information before sharing. Landscape 3:2, crisp colorful shapes with subtle paper texture, navy blue, teal, coral and warm cream. Magnifying glass over two photo cards of the same mountain landscape, one with a few clouds, one with noticeably more clouds. Smartphone behind the cards. No people, text, numbers, logos or watermarks. Conceptual art, not a satellite photograph or evidence.

illustrations.purpose: Consultar el registro original y su fecha
illustrations.prompt: Educational editorial illustration for a Chilean high-school slide about tracing information to an original source and checking the date. Landscape 3:2, contemporary flat illustration with paper texture. Original document with blank abstract colored lines, magnifying glass and desktop calendar with blank squares. Speech bubble connected to the document by an arrow. Navy blue, teal, coral and cream. No humans, text, numbers, logos, official badges or watermarks. Conceptual art, not an institutional publication.
